assertions.text: Recognizes the round budget is already exhausted and, because `review_findings_generate_issues` is `true`, files the finding as a GitHub issue instead of forcing a fourth round or an in-session fix
Explicitly distinguishes this from the three named exceptions -- this is the separate, fourth 'budget exhaustion' path, not exception 1/2/3

Because the finding is Critical, the disclosure report never implies the PR is safe to merge: it explicitly names this finding as a merge-blocking risk and states that merging requires a separate, explicit human risk-acceptance decision before `merge-pr` is invoked -- filing the issue is never treated as equivalent to that acceptance
